source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Description , Turn on the system and enter Setup. Enter the "Integrated Devices" menu in Setup.
Input Data
The menu should include a field named "OS Watchdog Timer".

2
Description
Select the OS Watchdog Timer field and press F1.
Input Data
The help text for the Watchdog Timer field should read:
"If your system stops responding, this watchdog timer aids in the recovery of your operating system. When this field is set to Enabled, the operating system is allowed to initialize the timer. When it is set to Disabled (the default), the timer will have no effect on the system."

3 Description
Press Esc to exit the help text. Press the arrow keys to scroll through all the selections for the field.
Input Data
The selections for the field should be "Enabled" and "Disabled".

4 Description
Set the field to "Enabled", then press Alt-F.
Input Data
The field should switch to "Disabled" since this is the default setting.

5 Description
Set the OS Watchdog Timer field to "Enabled". Save the change and reboot. Using an ICE, stop the system just before it is about to execute int 19h to boot.
Using the ICE, view the Watchdog Resource Table (WDAT) in the F000h block (the address of this table can be found in the BIOS.MAP file at the "WDAT" label).
Input Data
Offset 03Ch, bit 0 in the WDAT should be 1 since the Watchdog Timer is enabled in Setup.

6 Description
Reboot the system, enter Setup, and set the OS Watchdog Timer field to "Disabled". Save the change and reboot. Using an ICE, stop the system just before it is about to execute int 19h to boot.
Again, view memory at the address of the Watchdog Resource Table (WDAT) in the F000h block.
Input Data
This time, the table "WDAT" should not exist since the Watchdog Timer is "Disabled" in Setup.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: operator to cut AC + BMC creds
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- AC drop 3 times: perform 3 AC drops (operator cuts AC then drops it back) and confirm the host/BMC recover. Agent logs host boot + BMC SEL after each drop; the physical AC action is operator-only.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return post-drop host boot marker + ipmitool -I lanplus -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" -H "$BMC_IP" sel elist 2>&1 | tail -30 so the user confirms clean recovery after each AC drop (3x); physical action is operator-performed.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: AC drop is physical + can lose unsaved state; operator performs the AC cut on a dedicated SUT.
deepseek_columns.remark: same code in 2 workbook rows (multi-row code)

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL is inapplicable because the three AC drops belong to duplicate row 1526; power recovery does not validate BIOS help/options/default or state-dependent WDAT representation, and its `ipmitool -P` handling exposes credentials.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / CHANGED correctly restores the BIOS/ICE method, rejects AC-drop substitution and requires the exact platform WDAT/default contract and trained operator.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 803/2291 repeats PARTIAL and the AC-drop overlay; duplicate entry 1525/2291 confirms that method belongs to the separate Sanity FW Matrix variant.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Its non-counting sequence-968 draft was inspected only as history; this review independently distinguishes a duplicate/prior-review association defect from a Master conflict and adds build-bound address provenance, read-only probe controls and alternate-method coverage accounting.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 permits a Project-approved evidence tool only with original-versus-actual coverage recorded, ED-36 treats BIOS.MAP/ICE availability as readiness rather than blocking, and ED-38 keeps interactive observations and verdicts engineer-owned.

original_test_intent: Verify the OS Watchdog Timer BIOS field, exact help text, Enabled/Disabled choices and default restoration, then prove the source-defined state-dependent firmware representation: Enabled exposes the mapped WDAT with Offset 03Ch bit 0 set, while Disabled exposes no WDAT table.
original_method: A trained engineer operates BIOS Setup, uses Alt-F as the source-defined default action, saves and reboots each state, halts the exact BIOS build before int 19h with a compatible ICE, and reads the WDAT location from that build's BIOS.MAP without writing memory.
manual_activity: A qualified BIOS/debug engineer verifies the physical or remote-console UI text and options, performs the default action and state changes, controls reboot and the pre-int 19h ICE halt, confirms the correct mapped address and observes recovery. Automation may only parse exported screenshots, map metadata and read-only dumps.
required_inputs: Exact platform/board and BIOS image hash/version, current and approved final watchdog state, Setup menu path, help text, choices and Alt-F/default behavior
Matching BIOS.MAP file and hash, WDAT symbol/address, authoritative definition of the source's Offset 03Ch bit 0 and expected Disabled table-absence rule
Compatible ICE/debug probe, firmware/tool version, connection and read-only halt/memory-capture SOP, trained operator and proof no writes are enabled
Boot mode and applicability of the source's F000h/int 19h assumptions; approved equivalent method plus coverage statement if the platform differs
Stable power, serial/OOB console, baseline export, reboot/halt timeout, abort, BIOS recovery and restored-state verification
safety_requirements: Do not perform the unrelated AC-drop test or use power loss as evidence for BIOS/WDAT behavior.
Do not infer, scan blindly for or reuse a WDAT address/offset from another BIOS build; bind BIOS.MAP and the memory dump to the exact running image.
Configure the ICE for read-only halt/capture and prohibit memory, register, flash or setup writes through the probe; do not attach or halt without the approved hardware/debug SOP.
Export Setup, host, BMC and SEL baselines before any approved clear; preserve first-failure and probe logs.
Maintain stable power and serial/OOB recovery; abort on wrong breakpoint/address, unexpected reset loop, firmware/setup corruption, probe fault or loss of management.
Do not automatically retry a halt or reboot. Restore the approved watchdog state, detach the probe safely and prove a clean boot and normal management path before closure.
agent_execution_scope: Before approval, perform only static input validation and no BIOS, reboot, ICE, debug or power action.
After engineer capture, verify map/image/dump provenance, decode only the approved field definition, compare Enabled and Disabled artifacts and organize UI/boot/log evidence.
Keep UI/default, Enabled WDAT field and Disabled table-absence checkpoints separate; do not infer one from another.
Do not operate BIOS/ICE, search arbitrary memory, invent offsets, expose credentials, clear evidence, retry or issue DUT PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the build-specific UI/default and WDAT map/field contract, method applicability, probe configuration and recovery plan.
Perform all BIOS, reboot, breakpoint, ICE read and visual observation steps, recording the exact image/map/dump provenance.
Restore the approved state, verify clean boot and issue per-checkpoint plus final DUT verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The AC drop 3 times method belongs to row 1526 and provides no BIOS UI, default-action or WDAT coverage; its credential-bearing IPMI invocation is also rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Keep the source's trained-operator BIOS/ICE flow with build-bound BIOS.MAP provenance and read-only capture. Offline parsing may assist only after the engineer exports the exact dump and authoritative field definition.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All six BIOS/ICE steps, exact help/options/default text, F000h/int 19h/BIOS.MAP method, Offset 03Ch bit 0 expectation, Disabled table absence, no Script and 10/10-minute estimates remain unmodified.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Fingerprint BIOS and map; capture UI/help/options/default; set Enabled and save; halt at the approved pre-boot point; export a read-only mapped WDAT dump and decode the approved field; repeat Disabled for table-absence evidence; restore state and cleanly boot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact BIOS build and debug-capable platform for which the source's Setup, F000h, int 19h and WDAT map assumptions are valid.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record system BIOS image/map hashes, board/CPLD/BMC, boot mode, ICE firmware and debug-software versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform BIOS Setup, BIOS.MAP/WDAT field and ICE/debug procedure for the exact build.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds strict image-map-dump provenance, explicit read-only probe controls and restoration evidence without altering the original UI or WDAT checkpoints.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A Project-approved ACPI table export or firmware debugger may provide equivalent WDAT content, but it does not automatically prove the original pre-int 19h ICE/F000h method; original and actual coverage must be recorded.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Exact build/map, authoritative field semantics, compatible read-only probe, operator and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A stale map or write-capable debugger can turn a read check into invalid evidence or firmware corruption.

project_override_considerations: If the project uses UEFI-only boot, another table location or a supported firmware/OS table exporter, it must preserve the original F000h/int 19h/ICE requirement, document why the actual method is equivalent, retain state-specific WDAT coverage and identify the original method not directly verified.
expected_evidence: Exact board, BIOS image and BIOS.MAP hashes; approved Setup path/help/options/default and final-state contract
Timestamped UI evidence for field, exact help text, choices and Alt-F/default behavior
Approved read-only ICE setup, breakpoint, probe/tool versions, stable-power/console record and no-write configuration
Enabled-state BIOS value plus address-bound WDAT dump and authoritative Offset 03Ch bit 0 decoding
Disabled-state BIOS value plus full approved search/map evidence supporting the source's table-absence claim
Reboot/halt timeline, BMC/host/SEL/probe logs, restored watchdog state, detached probe, clean boot and engineer verdicts

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Within row 804, Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define BIOS UI/default and state-dependent WDAT inspection. The duplicate row and copied DeepSeek AC-drop overlay are disambiguated by Source Key and are prior-review/data-association defects; build-specific WDAT applicability is a Project readiness question rather than an internal semantic contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The core UI, Enabled-table and Disabled-table checkpoints are explicit. Exact BIOS map, probe and platform applicability affect whether and how the case can execute, but do not prevent completion of the Review or require AI to choose between conflicting targets.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects AC-drop substitution and unsafe credential handling, restoring zero lost BIOS/WDAT coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on MANUAL ONLY and strengthens exact-image map provenance, no-write enforcement and alternative-method coverage reporting.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces PARTIAL command review with the source's actual operator/debug boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Keeps the manual flow but corrects source-conflict accounting and adds exact breakpoint/address validation and full Disabled absence evidence.

review_improvement: Makes the fixed address and bit claim auditable only against the exact BIOS build, prevents a write-capable debug session or unrelated AC cycling, and preserves manual UI plus pre-boot table coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: The decisive observations occur before normal OS control and depend on interactive Setup and a build-specific hardware debugger. Offline automation can decode exported artifacts but cannot truthfully claim the field, default action, breakpoint or no-table observation. Because the source's checkpoints agree and platform differences can be handled by Project applicability and documented overrides, the proper class is MANUAL ONLY rather than BLOCKED.
